description: The SAT model-witness acceptor component: check-stream(problem: list<s32>, model: list<s32>) and check-nested(problem: list<list<s32>>, model: list<s32>). Expected outcomes follow Silmaril.Logic.SAT.Carrier.satStream / satNested.

sat.source: Silmaril.Wasm.Examples.SatAccept: prog, wrapped as a component (memory 0, realloc cabi_realloc)

cases.name: stream-sattwo-model
cases.note: [[1,2],[-1,2]] with model {2}; Carrier.Examples.satTwo_stream_accepted

cases.name: stream-empty-formula
cases.note: the empty stream is the empty formula (satisfiable), not malformed; empty_stream_sat

cases.name: stream-extreme-literals
cases.note: the largest literals ±(2^31-1)

cases.name: stream-incomplete-model
cases.note: clause [-1,2] has no model literal

cases.name: stream-inconsistent-model
cases.note: a literal and its negation

cases.name: stream-model-zero
cases.note: 0 is not a literal word

cases.name: stream-model-intmin
cases.note: Int32.MIN is not a literal word

cases.name: stream-empty-clause
cases.note: [0] is the formula [[]] (unsatisfiable), distinct from the empty stream

cases.name: stream-unterminated
cases.note: an unterminated last clause is malformed, not dropped

cases.name: stream-unterminated-tail
cases.note: malformed even though the model hits every literal

cases.name: stream-intmin-literal
cases.note: Int32.MIN in the problem is malformed

cases.name: stream-too-large
cases.note: 1.2 MB of words exceed the 1 MiB memory: cabi_realloc answers memBytes and the canonical ABI's bounds check fails. The canonical ABI specifies a trap (trap_if in definitions.py); Wasmtime 50 reports it as a host error ('realloc return: beyond end of memory'), not a wasmtime::Trap, so the harness records `error`. Either way the call is not accepted.

cases.name: nested-sattwo-model
cases.note: satTwo; Carrier.Examples.satTwo_accepted

cases.name: nested-empty-formula
cases.note: [] is the empty formula; empty_nested_sat

cases.name: nested-empty-clause
cases.note: [[]] has the empty clause: unsatisfiable

cases.name: nested-incomplete-model
cases.note: clause [2] not hit

cases.name: nested-inner-zero
cases.note: a 0 inside a clause is malformed (never a separator); malformed_nested_inner_zero

cases.name: nested-zero
cases.note: [[0]] is malformed

cases.name: nested-intmin
cases.note: Int32.MIN in a clause is malformed

cases.name: nested-too-large
cases.note: an inner list beyond memory: the canonical ABI's bounds check fails. The canonical ABI specifies a trap (trap_if in definitions.py); Wasmtime 50 reports it as a host error ('realloc return: beyond end of memory'), not a wasmtime::Trap, so the harness records `error`. Either way the call is not accepted.
